SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / COUNT(*)::float, 3) as avg_yt_per_trip,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cls, ', ') as classes
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 6
GROUP BY fished_date_doy
ORDER BY fished_date_doy
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ts_hour,
  ROUND(wtmp_c::float * 9/5 + 32, 1) as wtmp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_doy >= 85 AND ts_season = 6
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC, ts_hour DESC
LIMIT 20;
